Kforce has a client that is seeking a BA/Functional Data Analyst in Tampa, FL.

Summary:
We are seeking an experienced BA/Functional Data Analyst to translate business needs into effective reporting and analytics solutions. This role partners with Finance, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze data, build data models, and develop actionable dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on experience in Power BI, Power Query, Excel, and SQL.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Gather and document reporting and data requirements from business stakeholders 
  Translate business needs into functional reporting and analytics solutions 
  Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports from scratch 
  Build and maintain data models supporting financial and operational reporting 
  Use Power Query to clean, transform, and combine data from multiple sources 
  Modify and troubleshoot existing SQL queries 
  Analyze revenue, costs, margins, profitability, and operational performance 
  Develop reports that provide actionable insights to Sales, Finance, and leadership 
  Validate requirements and recommend alternatives when requests are not technically feasible or scalable 
  Maintain and enhance existing dashboards, queries, and reporting tools 
  Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity 
  Identify opportunities to automate reporting and reduce manual processes 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field preferred 
  Experience in business analysis, functional analysis, data analytics, or reporting 
  Strong hands-on Power BI experience 
  Experience developing dashboards and data models from scratch 
  Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders 
  Working knowledge of SQL 
  Strong Power Query skills 
  Strong Microsoft Excel skills 
  Strong financial and operational data analysis skills 
  Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities 
  Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities independently 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Microsoft Dynamics or similar ERP experience 
  Finance or accounting reporting experience 
  Sales, margin, and profitability analysis experience 
  Tableau experience 
  Reporting automation and process improvement experience 

 
Key Skills:
 
  Business Analysis 
  Functional Requirements Gathering 
  Data Analysis 
  Power BI 
  Power Query 
  Data Modeling 
  Dashboard Development 
  SQL 
  Microsoft Excel 
  Financial Analysis 
  Margin & Profitability Analysis 
  Sales Reporting 
  Data Visualization 
  Data Transformation 
  Reporting Automation

Kforce has a client that is seeking a Software Engineer - AI-Assisted Development in Draper, UT.

Overview:
We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer who is excited about using modern AI development tools to build software faster and more effectively. You will work primarily with Node.js, Python, and Microsoft Azure, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code as part of your everyday development workflow.

This is not an AI/ML research or data science role. We are looking for a strong software developer who knows how to use AI as an engineering accelerator while still applying sound technical judgment to the code and solutions being produced.

Essential Functions:
 
  Build and enhance applications, services, APIs, integrations, and automation using Node.js and Python 
  Develop and integrate solutions within a Microsoft Azure environment 
  Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools to accelerate software development 
  Use AI to analyze existing codebases, troubleshoot issues, develop new functionality, generate tests, and refactor applications 
  Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, performance, simplicity, and security 
  Recognize when an AI-generated solution is overly complex, incorrect, or inappropriate and determine a better approach 
  Work with GitHub and/or Azure DevOps for source control, pull requests, CI/CD, and collaborative development 
  Build and integrate REST APIs and cloud-based services 
  Take defined engineering problems from requirements through implementation and delivery 
 
 
  Strong hands-on software development experience with Node.js and/or Python 
  Experience developing applications or services in Microsoft Azure 
  Experience working with REST APIs and application/service integrations 
  Hands-on experience using modern AI coding tools as part of real software development work 
  Ability to understand and critically evaluate AI-generated code rather than simply accept its output 
  Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively in an iterative development environment 
  A pragmatic, hands-on approach to solving technical problems 

 
Solid foundation in software engineering practices including:
 
  Git and source control 
  Pull requests and code reviews 
  Automated testing 
  CI/CD 
  Debugging and troubleshooting 
  Maintainable, production-quality development 

 
Who This Role Is Great For:
This opportunity could be an especially strong fit for a junior-to-mid-level engineer who is hungry to grow quickly. You don't need to be an AI researcher, security expert, solution architect, or principal engineer. We're looking for someone who is:
 
  Curious 
  Technically capable 
  Comfortable moving quickly 
  Motivated to build 
  Willing to experiment 
  Excited about how AI is changing software development 
  Interested in continuing to grow toward senior-level engineering responsibilities 

 
Nice to Have:
 
  .NET/C# development experience 
  Experience building AI agents or agent-driven workflows 
  Experience developing tools, APIs, or integrations that AI agents can invoke 
  Familiarity with application or cloud security 
  Exposure to security or vulnerability-management technologies such as Wiz, Tenable, GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk, SonarQube, Veracode, Checkmarx, or similar tools 
  Experience automating security-related engineering workflows
